summary: Solid test suite with good modular organization covering all three retention policies, input validation, CLI integration, rendering, and workflow structure. Tests are well-named and use appropriate fixtures. Main gaps: missing exact boundary-condition tests (e.g., artifact exactly at maxAgeDays threshold, size exactly at budget); missing coverage of DRY_RUN env var with non-standard values ('false', '0'); act-harness.ts exists but is separate implementation rather than integrated into bun test suite. Would catch most regressions in core logic and happy paths, but some edge cases (Infinity, boundary ages) could be more thorough.
